assessments.rationale: The website-conversion journey has no procedure for PCAP conversations, capture/display filtering, TLS hostname visibility, retransmission or latency evidence, or stream reconstruction.
This first-pass pattern router neither analyzes packet conversations nor provides the required filter, TLS, latency, and cleartext-stream procedures; it explicitly routes full diagnosis out.

It supplies PCAP triage, conversation narrowing, display filters, retransmission indication, TLS/SNI visibility, and stream following, but it does not provide a concrete latency-evidence procedure or clearly distinguish capture-time from post-capture filtering for this troubleshooting task.
This is limited to clinical record or study summaries and contains no packet-capture, network-latency, TLS, filter, or stream-reconstruction method.

It covers authorized TShark capture analysis, capture versus display filters, conversations, TLS server names, extraction, and stream reconstruction, but it lacks a method to identify and summarize retransmissions and latency evidence behind the slowdown.
The skill compares public competitors and offers; it provides no method for analyzing a supplied capture, encrypted handshakes, performance evidence, or cleartext streams.
This is a documented UI-convention research procedure, not a PCAP analysis workflow, and does not address conversations, packet filtering, TLS, retransmissions, latency, or streams.

It directly supports authorized PCAP troubleshooting: relevant conversations, explicit capture-filter versus display-filter distinction, retransmission and latency checks, TLS SNI extraction, one selected TCP-stream reconstruction, and exportable artifacts.
